name: Nexis CRO
summary: Shopify app that runs a 34-check SEO and AEO audit across products, collections, pages and policies, rewrites the gaps with AI, deploys JSON-LD schema and an llms.txt file, and tracks whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity cite your store.
best_for: Shopify merchants who already care about being cited in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, and who want the audit, the schema deployment, the llms.txt file and the citation tracking in one app instead of stitching them together.
skip_if: you already run a mature SEO app, you want proven tooling rather than a new one, or AI-chat visibility is not yet a business question for your store
honest_knock: It has no track record at all. The app launched on 9 June 2026 and its App Store listing still showed a 0.0 rating from zero reviews when we read it on 14 September and again on 3 October 2026 — so every claim about what the audit catches, how good the AI rewrites are and whether the citation tracking is accurate rests on the vendor's own description. That matters more than usual here, because AEO tracking is a young field: nobody has yet shown that being cited by ChatGPT or Perplexity moves revenue, and the numbers a tracker reports are hard for a merchant to check independently. The free tier is also thin — 5 AI credits and one audit a month is enough to see the interface, not to test the product.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per month, or $99 a year
pricing.notes: (read 14 September 2026 and re-read unchanged on 3 October 2026 on apps.shopify.com/nexis-cro-ai-seo-aeo-audit) Free, then Pro $9 a month or $99 a year, Growth $21 or $121, and Agency $44 or $344. All charges are in USD and recur every 30 days, and the paid tiers carry a 2-day free trial — short for judging a tool whose whole promise is a change in how AI engines see you. The meter is AI credits: Free gives 5 a month and a single audit, Pro 100 with unlimited audits and history, Growth 300, Agency 500. Read Agency's “500 AI credits (unlimited usage)” against that number rather than past it: the credits are the ceiling. The yearly discounts the vendor advertises do hold up when you check them — 8% on Pro, 52% on Growth, 35% on Agency.
